bullets.text: In Uthukottai, a biker died when a roadside banner collapsed on him, and the office should monitor action against illegal banners.
In Chennai, a biker named Suresh Vasudevan died after a funeral garland got stuck in his wheel, and the office should watch road safety.
In Thiruvallur, a report highlighted massive sand theft in a lake, and the office should verify enforcement actions against the illegal mining.
In Ponneri, a 75-year-old man died after being hit by a government bus on a damaged road, and the office should expedite road repairs.
In Uthukottai, social activists urged authorities to repair potholes on the Tamaraipakkam barrage bridge, and the office should ensure immediate fixing.
In Gummidipoondi, the US FDA assigned an OAI classification to the Caplin Steriles facility, and the office should review the regulatory compliance.
The Tamil Nadu government plans to move film shooting permissions entirely online, and the office should track the rollout of this digital portal.
Tamil Nadu is probing irregularities in public library book purchases involving AI-generated content, and the office should monitor the investigation.
Yotta Data Services raised a 315 million dollar loan for AI infrastructure, and the office should watch data centre investments in the state.
